privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Chant Karo is built so that your practice can stay private. This page explains, in plain language, what stays on your device and what — if anything — reaches our server.
privacy.noAccountBody: You never need to log in, register, or provide an email address, phone number or any personal detail to use Chant Karo.
privacy.onDeviceBody: Your selected practices, custom chants and affirmations, session and lifetime counts, targets, profiles, theme and language preferences are stored locally in your browser (LocalStorage). None of this is sent to our server. Clearing your browser data, using private browsing, or switching devices can remove it — you can export a backup at any time from Settings.
privacy.voiceModeBody: Voice Mode is optional and off until you explicitly start it. Chant Karo does not record, store or receive your voice. Your browser or device may process speech using its own built-in or cloud speech-recognition service, outside of Chant Karo's control — please review your browser's own privacy settings. We never store or transmit the transcript.
privacy.globalTotalsBody: If "Contribute to Global Totals" is on, your device periodically sends only a category (chant or affirmation) and a positive whole-number increment, together with a random idempotency key used purely to prevent double-counting. We never receive your selected chant text, custom wording, religion, voice, personal history, or any identifying information. You can turn this off at any time in Settings; personal counting keeps working exactly the same either way.
privacy.yourControlBullet1: Export your local data as a JSON file at any time.
privacy.yourControlBullet2: Import a previously exported file to restore your progress.
privacy.yourControlBullet3: Clear all local data permanently from Settings.
privacy.serverLogsBody: Our hosting and API infrastructure may temporarily process essential technical logs (such as request timestamps and error rates) for security, abuse prevention and reliability. These logs are kept for the minimum practical period and are not used to build personal profiles.
privacy.independenceBody: Chant Karo is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated on behalf of any religious organization, unless explicitly stated otherwise.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy can be sent to <1>bhupi166@gmail.com</1>.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using Chant Karo, you agree to the following terms.
terms.whatItIsBody: Chant Karo is a free counting and personal-practice tool for chants, prayers, simran, dhikr and positive affirmations. It helps you count repetitions by tap or voice and keep a private record of your practice.
terms.whatItIsNotBullet1: It does not provide religious, spiritual, medical or mental-health advice.
terms.whatItIsNotBullet2: It does not guarantee any spiritual, medical, financial or personal outcome.
terms.whatItIsNotBullet3: Voice-recognition accuracy is not guaranteed and may vary by device, browser and accent.
terms.followTraditionBody: Suggested phrases are provided for convenient counting only. Please follow the wording, pronunciation and guidance of your own spiritual tradition or teacher. Traditions are presented neutrally in this app and are not ranked or compared.
terms.customContentBody: Any custom chant, prayer or affirmation you enter is your own responsibility. Please use it lawfully and respectfully. Custom text is stored only in your browser and is never transmitted to our server.
terms.availabilityBody: Chant Karo is provided "as is" and free of charge. We aim for high reliability but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability of the global-totals service; personal counting continues to work even when it is unavailable.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated terms.

about.title: About Chant Karo
about.paragraph1: Chant Karo is a free, inclusive repetition counter for people of every faith and for people practising positive affirmations. Every faith. Every positive thought. One peaceful community.
about.paragraph2: Choose a suggested chant, prayer or affirmation — or enter your own — and count repetitions by tap or by voice. No login, no registration, no personal details. Your progress stays privately in your browser.
about.paragraph3: Chant Karo is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated on behalf of any religious organization or denomination.
about.whyBody: Counting repetitions with a physical mala, tasbih or tally is a practice millions of people already know. Chant Karo brings that same simple counting into a calm, private, digital space — without asking anything of you beyond a tap or a spoken word.

benefits.title: Benefits of Chanting & Affirmations
benefits.intro: These reflect common, personally reported experiences of steady practice — not medical or guaranteed outcomes. Chant Karo does not provide medical or mental-health advice; see our <1>Terms of Use</1>.
benefits.chant1Body: Repeating sacred words may help the mind slow down and create a moment of calm.
benefits.chant2Body: Focusing on one chant can help reduce everyday distractions during the practice.
benefits.chant3Body: Personal counts and optional targets can encourage regular spiritual practice.
benefits.chant4Body: Chanting can provide personal time for devotion, prayer and remembrance.
benefits.chant5Body: A meaningful chant may support gratitude, hope and inner positivity.
benefits.affirmation1Body: Repeating constructive words can help develop a kinder internal voice.
benefits.affirmation2Body: Positive affirmations may remind users of their abilities and personal strengths.
benefits.affirmation3Body: An affirmation can help users focus on the attitude they want to carry throughout the day.
benefits.affirmation4Body: Regular repetition may help users approach everyday situations more thoughtfully.
benefits.affirmation5Body: Morning and evening affirmations can become a simple, peaceful daily habit.
